title: United Natural Foods Shares 2026 Spring and Summer Retail Trends
summary: Fresh, wellness-forward products and experiences bring emerging opportunities for retailers to differentiate and compete At its 2026 Spring and Summer Selling Show in Orlando, Fla., United Natural Foods, Inc. (NYSE: UNFI) brought more than 3,400 retailers and suppliers together to explore innovative products and help customers create value for their shoppers this spring and summer selling season.
